status: Selected official Mihomo defines configuration semantics; client owns host settings, bounded resources and transactional application

subscription_updates.route: Direct by default; explicit RunningProxy or Auto; Auto retries one direct network failure through the ready owned core, never TLS/auth/content failures
subscription_updates.redirects: at most 5 HTTP/HTTPS hops; reject downgrade, login details, fragments and loops; drop custom source headers across origins; no cookies
subscription_updates.deadline: 15 seconds per transfer, 20 seconds total across redirects and fallback; aggregate decoded response bodies at most 16 MiB
subscription_updates.conditional_cache: ETag and Last-Modified in DPAPI envelope bound to source URL/headers and sourceHash; send only to matching final URL; 304 requires verified local raw source or one unconditional refetch
subscription_updates.other_failure_backoff: at least 60 minutes and no shorter than configured interval
subscription_updates.activation: changed selected profile with autoApply uses confirmed transaction and compensation; stopped updates never start core
subscription_updates.unchanged: refresh metadata without core restart unless pending candidate awaits apply
subscription_updates.selection_identity: profileId, group policy HMAC without members, member HMAC and membership/capability readback

limits.scope: node/group/rule counts apply to parsed static entries and structured fallback; opaque native provider bodies use byte budgets

proxies.validation: All protocols, transports, credentials and nested options are interpreted by the selected official core; no duplicate client protocol allowlist
proxies.projection: bounded scalar name/type for static entries

compatibility.hysteria2_mport: normalize to ports; explicit ports wins
compatibility.proxy_vendor_extensions: bounded scalar x- metadata omitted from effective nodes and disclosed; source retained

groups.validation: selected official core validates group types/options/references; no duplicate client allowlist
groups.manual_selection: Selector only; automatic groups use live core readback; load balance has no fabricated current node

rules.validation: all core-supported rule types/options and sub-rules; client bounds scalar size/count, core validates semantics/references

passthrough: Preserve core configuration options except application-owned host settings and managed resource paths

managed.secret: absent from semantic template; required per session with >=256-bit randomness

dns.enable: preserve validated subscription; false if absent

rejected: unmanaged provider paths and missing external resources
invalid configuration or provider bodies rejected by official core

dns.validation: selected official core; preserve options including resolver protocols, policy/filter/cache settings
dns.managed: listen empty; absent DNS disabled; application DNS mode override retained; no subscription-controlled OS listener

geo.snapshot: release_matrix.json geo by default; managed immutable geoip/geosite pair after explicit update
geo.writer: application only; stream at most 64 KiB per read and 32 MiB per database; verify existing hash paths before reuse; isolated official dual-database validation and normal configuration transaction
geo.manual_update: fixed MetaCubeX HTTPS sources; pair unchanged avoids restart; download/validation cancellation rejects late replies; previous pair and explicit bundled fallback retained
geo.tun: bundled resources only until managed service resource support

providers.default_mode: snapshot for simple standard YAML/text; automatically retain runtime semantics for filters/overrides/complex dependencies/file/MRS/native proxy bodies
providers.accepted: inline, explicit HTTP/HTTPS, local file copied under user context; rules YAML/text/MRS and native core-supported proxy bodies
providers.snapshot_download: application writer; at most 5 safe HTTP/HTTPS redirects, reject HTTPS downgrade/loops and drop custom headers across origins; 10 seconds transfer/15 seconds total; 64 KiB chunks; 32 resources, 4 MiB each, 16 MiB total; immutable source/body SHA-256 binding
providers.snapshot_refresh: download selected resource only; verified cache for the rest; missing or corrupt cache requires full update; failed candidate preserves old state
providers.runtime_config: generated paths from kind/name/source/format/behavior; structured fallback for standard YAML/text, otherwise exact bounded bytes in Base64 metadata and seeded generated cache
providers.runtime_writer: core only while running; application/service removes inactive or oversized generated files only while core stopped; refuse links, directories and unknown entries; at most 32 files/128 MiB body cache
providers.runtime_network: pinned core TLS/redirect/parser behavior; YAML rules require standard multiline payload; malformed individual rules can be ignored by core; read back actual ruleCount
providers.runtime_refresh: fixed PUT provider endpoint; service accepts only active allowlisted kind/name, no URL/path/extra fields; no core restart or snapshot mutation; timeout outcome uncertain, no automatic retry
providers.selection: provider-only nodes and static/dynamic name collisions are unverified; explicit live selection allowed, never persist or automatically restore; failed provider readback cannot authorize restore
providers.history_backup: immutable import fallback only; standard sources can flatten, native bodies remain managed offline file providers; no live cache or remote fetch
providers.service_validation: fixed command boundary tested; actual installed service and TUN integration tracked separately in P3-25
providers.body_validation: official -t plus offline AppContainer file-provider loading and fixed provider PUT for opaque native bodies; no data listener/healthcheck/system changes
providers.file_paths: relative to explicitly imported local file; remote source has no implicit base directory; service consumes only bounded copied bytes and generated paths

diagnostics.privacy: fixed feature vocabulary, structural index paths, phase only; never arbitrary YAML keys, names, URLs or values; English and Chinese presentation

parser: yaml-cpp 0.9.0; single document, duplicate keys rejected; bounded anchors/aliases/merge expansion; original bytes stored separately
subscription_formats: URI node list parsed by official core
Base64 node list parsed by official core
